about_the_game:
An epic snowball fight between 2-4 players, both online and local multiplayer. Grow your snowball and use different power-up's to knock your friends out! Are you ready to Brawll?

This free demo lets you experience the core gameplay of Brawll through the Deathmatch mode.

  • Supports 2–4 players, local multiplayer.

  • Includes 10 unique maps, each with interactive elements like portals, moving blocks, and bells that change the environment.

  • Fully playable with basic snowball combat mechanics, including throwing, charging, and headbutting.

  • Try out a variety of map-based tactics and player interactions.

This demo is focused on delivering a fun, fast-paced combat experience in limited settings.
Please note: More maps, mechanics and gamemodes will be available on the full version of the game. This demo will give you an overall idea of how the game will be.

Estimated playtime: 15–30 minutes, depending on how many rounds you play.

FUN COMBAT

  • "SNOWBALL INCOMINGGG!"

Throw your snowball to knock them out. But don't miss, you are extremely vulnerable without a snowball.

  • "FULL CHARGEEE!"

Get in a head-to-head battle and headbutt your friends like a stubborn goat.

INTERACT WITH THE MAP

The map is yours to get the upper hand. Use it and surprise your friends.

  • "PORTALS!"

Use the portals located in the map to hit them when they are not expecting! (Have you tried throwing your snowball to the portal?)

  • "OMG! MAP IS CHANGING"

Hit the bell, move the blocks to have some unexpected falls!

"An animal takes a step and falls from the moved block you think that of me? No, I am the one who hits the bell."

- Puffin

MOST IMPORTANTLY

Don't forget to have fun and show your friends that you are better than them in video games.

short_description: Snowbrawll demo is a local party game demo with up to 4 players. Crush your friends in an epic snowball fight, throw your snowball, and knock them off the cliff. Roll up the biggest snowball, yeet it with style and become the ultimate snowball champion. Are you ready to Brawll?
